title: "I KNOW THAT MY REDEEMER LIVES."[A]
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Published 1903. The Roberts-Van Der Donckt debate on the nature of God, plus Roberts' treatise on Mormon doctrine of deity.

footnotes.text: This discourse was delivered in the Tabernacle, Salt Lake City, March 16,1902, and by the kind permission of President Smith I am allowed to reproduce it here.
